contents: # Log of incoming API requests (table api_request_log, create it with a migration):
# usage statistics via "bin/console laba:service:api-usage" and GET /api/api_usage.
entity_manager: default # entity manager of the api_request_log table, e.g. "log" for a separate logs database
keep_last: '90 days'    # older rows are deleted by laba:loggable:apply-retention; null: kept forever
# /api is always protected: only the Laba services listed here can call it, each with its own key
# (x-api-key). A valid key gets ROLE_API and its roles. Locally the keys come from `make secrets`
# of Laba/Traefik (API_CLIENT_<CALLER>_KEY). The API docs (/api, /api/docs) need no key in dev only.
# Errors go to Sentry when SENTRY_DSN is set (e.g. in .env.local or the environment of prod).
